rule: Every fixture is a known reject. Deterministic guards block objective substitutions; the human rubric judges only the real perceptual requirement.

deterministic_guard.requirement: Reject any source path listed in retired_paths even when its folder or filename says approved or final.

human_rubric.question: Does the rendered title use the current LAiDIES wordmark treatment?
human_rubric.fail_when: A retired logo or materially different wordmark is visible.

deterministic_guard.requirement: Bind the exact active heroine identity reference before generation or assembly.

human_rubric.question: Is the heroine recognizably the admitted character in every required view?
human_rubric.fail_when: Face, age, silhouette or character identity drifts from the admitted reference.

deterministic_guard.requirement: Bind the product-specific wardrobe role and reject every forbidden_substitutions value.

human_rubric.question: Does the full visible outfit match the admitted product-specific reference?
human_rubric.fail_when: Any garment, shoe or accessory revives a rejected or wrong-episode treatment.

deterministic_guard.requirement: Accept only the checksum-bound town.canonical-map role; reject historical or generated substitute geography.

human_rubric.question: Does the visible geography agree with the canonical town map and named destination relationships?
human_rubric.fail_when: A street, building or route is invented, moved or mislabeled.

needles: MAiVENS are incorrectly presented as town characters

deterministic_guard.requirement: Every named character must resolve to the current roster and permitted narrative role before picture production.

human_rubric.question: Does each visible person belong in this scene and perform the role the narration assigns?
human_rubric.fail_when: A historical MAiVEN, invented extra or unrelated character is presented as a town resident or distracts from the teaching job.

needles: native default captions over the picture

deterministic_guard.requirement: Require the external caption track and a dedicated below-picture rail; disallow default burned or native overlay presentation.

human_rubric.question: Are readable synchronized captions below the picture at desktop, mobile and zoomed layouts?
human_rubric.fail_when: Captions cover meaningful picture content, clip, overflow or become unreadable.

needles: caption capitalization is not preserving approved spelled terms

deterministic_guard.requirement: Compare caption tokens with the canonical term allowlist before packaging.

human_rubric.question: Do captions preserve intended names and stylized terms without harming readability?
human_rubric.fail_when: LAiDIES names or product terms are recased, misspelled or semantically altered.

needles: predominantly as static slides rather than meaningful narration-synchronised animation

deterministic_guard.requirement: Require occurrence-level motion intent and observed-result verdicts before full assembly; camera drift does not count as meaningful motion.

human_rubric.question: At normal speed, does picture or local motion develop with the narration rather than hold as a slideshow?
human_rubric.fail_when: Long static holds, generic pans or zooms replace meaningful action, progression or environmental life.

deterministic_guard.requirement: Every overlay must have an occurrence-level narration or purpose job; otherwise block the assembly.

human_rubric.question: Does every overlay clarify the current idea without covering the scene or looking like an unrelated rectangular light box?
human_rubric.fail_when: An overlay lacks a narration job, obscures meaningful content or repeats as generic decoration.

deterministic_guard.requirement: Every required motion occurrence needs a bound output and independent observed-result verdict before title assembly passes.

human_rubric.question: Does each beat that requires change, action or explanation visibly animate at the right narration moment?
human_rubric.fail_when: A required event is absent, frozen, mistimed or replaced by unrelated motion.
